The '''AFLA''' is the [[FLLA]]-affiliated continental football confederation for [[Ayuma]]. It was allocated 5 berths at the [[1764 FLLA World Cup]], at which it was represented by [[Emara]], [[Lycroa]], [[Verusa]], [[Easuhura]] and [[Siana]].
